n.quote: a total of 311 Americans from MTurk were recruited

es.location: Manuscript p. 21, Study 3a Results; p. 45, Table 7.
es.quote:
In an independent samples t-test we found a medium to strong ownership effect, with

sellers’ mean log price (M = 2.71, SD = .85) higher than buyers’ mean log price (M = 2.21,

SD = .68; t(295.06) = 5.71, p < .001, d = .65).

reported_success.quote: We concluded that these findings represent a successful replication of both the ownership effect and the moderation effect of transaction demand.
